name: Gästehaus Gapp
beschreibung: Gästehaus Gapp is located in the charming community of Wildermieming in the Tyrolean Oberland. It is a traditional alpine inn offering a cozy and welcoming ambiance. Guests are treated to genuine hospitality and delicious regional cuisine. The surrounding plateau features numerous scenic hiking and cycling trails. The guest rooms are thoughtfully appointed with contemporary conveniences to ensure a relaxing stay. During the summer months, the lovely outdoor garden invites visitors to linger and unwind. Thanks to its peaceful setting, guests can fully recharge in nature. Gästehaus Gapp serves as an excellent base for discovering the Tyrolean Alps.
